$comment: Host overload cascade. Defaults live in host-overload-settings.mjs; override host.maxWaitMs (900000 milliseconds: mandatory gates wait for host load, then proceed through slot admission; WE_HOST_MAX_WAIT_MS overrides), host.maxLoadPerCore (2.0), host.minMemoryHeadroomMb (2048: free RAM + free swap in MB below which no new background heavy job or review session starts; it waits), host.maxReviewDispatchPerTick (2 new review sessions per review-daemon tick at most), lanes.transcripts.explicitScan (true: permits explicit requests only), or lanes.gc.schedule (86400000 milliseconds between completed serialized passes). Routine whois NEVER scans. lane-pool gc is the scheduled maintenance entrypoint.
